records.title: Tab key moves focus through the page
records.steps: Load the homepage, press Tab 15 times, record document.activeElement after each press
records.expected: At least 3 distinct elements receive focus
records.actual: 13 distinct element(s): a "Skip to content", a "Fixture Store", a "Shop all", a "Contact", a "Cart", input "q", button "Search", a "Good Tee"
records.impact: Keyboard users cannot reach the controls.
records.fix: Use native links/buttons; remove tabindex="-1" and focus traps.

records.title: Focused elements show a visible focus indicator
records.steps: Load the homepage, press Tab 15 times, record document.activeElement after each press; read computed outline and box-shadow
records.expected: At least 80% of focused elements have an outline or box-shadow
records.actual: 13 of 13 show an outline or box-shadow. Without one: none. Heuristic: other indicators (background, border) are not detected; confirm by eye.
records.impact: Keyboard users cannot see where they are (WCAG 2.4.7).
records.fix: Remove outline:none or add a :focus-visible style.

records.title: Skip link is the first Tab stop
records.steps: Load the homepage, press Tab 15 times, record document.activeElement after each press
records.expected: First focused element is an in-page link (href="#...")
records.impact: Keyboard users must tab through the whole header on every page (WCAG 2.4.1).
records.fix: Add a "Skip to content" link as the first element in <body>.
